sources.title: A theory of cerebellar cortex

sources.title: Reevaluating the Role of LTD in Cerebellar Motor Learning

sources.key_claim: PF-PC LTD expression (AMPAR endocytosis) is not a necessary rate-limiting step for cerebellar motor learning

sources.title: Depressed by learning — heterogeneity of the plasticity rules at parallel fiber synapses onto Purkinje cells
sources.usage: flocculus optimal PF-CF pairing interval ~120ms matching visual feedback delay; zone-specific LTD timing
sources.key_claim: LTD induction rules are locally tuned to behavioral requirements; optimal pairing interval ~120ms in flocculus

sources.authors: Zhu L, Bhumbra GS, Bhatt D, et al.
sources.title: Mesoscale simulations predict the role of synergistic cerebellar plasticity during classical eyeblink conditioning
sources.usage: computational model showing PF-PC LTD + MLI LTP synergistic roles in CEBC; combined knockout required for major impairment
sources.key_claim: PF-PC LTD and MLI feedforward inhibition act synergistically; neither alone is sufficient for optimal CEBC

sources.authors: Wang X, Liu N, Angelov A, et al.
sources.title: Excitatory nucleo-olivary pathway shapes cerebellar outputs for motor control
sources.usage: fastigial nucleus has excitatory (glutamatergic) projections to IO; active during saccades; challenges dogma of purely inhibitory nucleo-olivary connection
sources.key_claim: Excitatory nucleo-olivary pathway generates well-timed complex spikes during high-velocity movements

sources.title: Cerebellar circuit computations for predictive motor control
sources.usage: 2025 review: high-dimensional granule cell coding; model-free implicit mappings; context-dependent learning; Purkinje cell population heterogeneity
sources.key_claim: Cerebellum may implement context-dependent motor learning through model-free implicit mappings rather than explicit internal models

sources.title: Error detection and representation in the olivo-cerebellar system
sources.usage: two-phase memory model: cerebellar cortex (LTD) for fast acquisition, DCN for slow consolidation
sources.key_claim: Motor memory consolidation involves transfer from cerebellar cortex (LTD) to deep cerebellar nuclei (DCN-LTP)

sources.title: Long-term depression and other synaptic plasticity in the cerebellum
sources.usage: comprehensive review of molecular cascade: mGluR1/Gq/PLC/IP3/DAG/PKC/GluA2-Ser880/PICK1/AMPAR endocytosis; interneuron plasticity; rebound potentiation
sources.key_claim: PF-PC LTD molecular cascade involves mGluR1-Gq-PLCβ4-IP3-PKCα-GluA2(Ser880 phosphorylation)-AMPAR endocytosis

sources.authors: Ichise T, Kano M, et al.
sources.title: Type-1 metabotropic glutamate receptor in cerebellar Purkinje cells: key molecule for LTD, endocannabinoid signalling and synapse elimination
sources.usage: mGluR1 localization at perisynaptic membrane; PLCβ4/IP3 downstream cascade; mGluR1 role in developmental synapse elimination; rescue experiments
sources.key_claim: mGluR1 concentrated at perisynaptic membrane; downstream PLCβ4/IP3 cascade essential; mGluR1 rescue restores LTD and motor learning
